stage: during model training and before national prediction freezing, intervention freezing, or target-discharge opening
issue: The initially referenced legacy common-date archive had been created for a post-evaluation sensitivity and used observed discharge and earlier model snow states to select dates. It therefore did not satisfy the stated outcome-blind definition.
resolution: The legacy archive was excluded. A new national archive was frozen from meteorological forcing alone: 12 unique June--September dates per gauge at the 0.05--0.95 quantiles of antecedent 30-day precipitation minus PET, with mean temperature above 5 degrees C.
effect_on_primary_intervention: all national interventions use only the replacement archive
